Class Grammar.Rule

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.syntax.Grammar.Rule
Enclosing class:
Grammar
public static final class Grammar.Rule extends Object
A single tokenizing rule: a TokenType plus either a regex Pattern or a literal multi-line open/close pair.

    • multiline

      public static Grammar.Rule multiline(TokenType type, String open, String close)
      Creates a multi-line rule that begins when open is found and continues until close is found on a later (or the same) line. Everything in between, across newlines, is emitted as a single token of the given type.
      Parameters:
      type - the token type
      open - the literal opener (e.g. /*)
      close - the literal closer (e.g. */)
      Returns:
      a new rule
